2608.04945.title: A General Sufficient Condition for Rewriting Horn-ALCHI Atomic Queries into GQL
2608.04945.paper_summary: The emergence of the ISO standard GQL introduces a powerful query language extending first-order logic with controlled recursion, raising the question of its applicability to evaluation of ontology-mediated queries (OMQs). We focus on OMQs consisting of atomic queries over ontologies expressed in Horn-ALCHI, an expressive Description Logic that is not, in general, first-order rewritable. To address this, we introduce DL automata, a novel formalism that captures the semantics of such OMQs via runs over fact sets. We then identify a large class of DL automata that can be rewritten into unions of conjunctive two-way regular path queries (UC2RPQs), a central fragment of GQL. Our class of automata relies on a stratification of their states, ruling out specific forms of cyclic dependencies known to raise the complexity. This yields a broad class of Horn-ALCHI OMQs that are GQL-rewritable.
2608.04945.paper_summary_zh: ISO 標準 GQL 的出現引入了一種強大的查詢語言，擴展了帶有受控遞歸的一階邏輯，提出了其在本體介導查詢 (OMQs) 評估中的適用性問題。<lb/>我們專注於由表達為 Horn-ALCHI 的本體的原子查詢組成的 OMQs，這是一種表達能力強的描述邏輯，通常不具有一階重寫性。<lb/>為了解決這個問題，我們引入了 DL 自動機，這是一種新穎的形式主義，通過在事實集上的運行來捕捉這類 OMQ 的語義。<lb/>然後，我們確定了一大類可以重寫為聯合的合取雙向正則路徑查詢 (UC2RPQs) 的 DL 自動機，這是 GQL 的一個核心片段。<lb/>我們的自動機類依賴於其狀態的分層，排除了已知會提高複雜性的特定形式的循環依賴。<lb/>這產生了一個廣泛的 Horn-ALCHI OMQ 類，這些 OMQ 是 GQL 可重寫的。
